subject: Marine Works - Fraser River
text:
Marine Works - Fraser River
Marine construction staging area, including derrick and scow barge, established in the vicinty of Deas Island.
Hours of operation 1400 UTC to 0200 UTC daily from Oct 16 to Oct 19.
On site vessels monitoring VHF channels 16, 71 and 74.
Mariners are advised to avoid the area and navigate via the main channel.
